summary: IRRBB Manager candidate with ~7 years across ALM, interest rate risk, and cash flow engine delivery. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios at Moody's Analytics ($5–25bn per engagement). Led design of a multi-scenario cash flow projection engine with behavioral overlays, supporting scenarios analogous to NII and EVE analytics. CFA charter; dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Engineering); Python and SQL proficient.

sections.heading: Cash Flow Engine & Balance Sheet Modeling
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios across ALM horizons — analogous to NII and EVE projection frameworks used in bank IRRBB programs.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) supporting balance sheet forecasting and funding optimization decisions.
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity and IRRBB expectations.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable, auditable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging and validation controls.

sections.heading: Interest Rate Risk Analytics & Model Governance
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios sized $5–25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative).
Oversee interest rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, aligned with IRRBB frameworks analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee standards.
Validate derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; reconcile sensitivities at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.
Review curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release; escalate outputs lacking economic defensibility.
Operate within formal model-governance framework — review assumptions, assess economic defensibility, and maintain documentation consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.

sections.heading: Scenario Analysis, Automation & Stakeholder Reporting
bullets: Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities; serve as primary escalation point for Heads of Risk on client-critical analytical issues.
Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) for code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reducing development cycle time ~30–40% on comparable modules.
Led onboarding and implementation of the PFaroe ALM system for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms; advised clients on asset, liability, and ALM configurations.
Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners; scoped requirements into development requests and validated model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from the legacy Calypso platform to the PFaroe PM environment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant – IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients; aligned regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes; coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, and risk functions on milestone delivery.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds; analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest rate risk and funding volatility under base and stressed environments.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest rate, inflation, and currency risk; modelled actuarial liabilities alongside major investment products.
Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis covering return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity trade-offs; presented findings to investment committees at pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) – Western University, 2016
